doc.title: Ruth Lion interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998

title: Alfred's honesty and pay to musicians
summary: Musicians were paid union scale and more; she calls Alfred the soul of honesty and giving.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: And the musicians were getting paid what the union scale—
He treated them right, is that correct?
He was the soul of honesty and givingness. I’m not just saying that because he was the love of my life. I can be objective in when I look and see, and I saw it. The man was just a beautiful person.
